remarks: Discover this charming one bedroom, one bath unit, ideally situated to showcase the allure of Mid-City living. Filled with natural light from two large west-facing walls of windows, this home provides a warm and welcoming ambiance. Inside, you'll find a generous living and dining area perfect for both relaxation and entertaining. The unit is equipped with plenty of closet space, providing ample room for all your belongings and helping to keep your living space neat and organized. Situated in a coveted doorman building, this residence has outstanding amenities, including a modern fitness center, a peaceful outdoor area and a community room (with kitchen) for socializing or quiet moments. Additional features include an on-site laundry facility and available garage parking for a monthly cost ($118). More than just a place to live, this is a lifestyle that combines comfort, convenience, and elegance in the heart of the city. New water heater and microwave. Painted and walk-in closet organizer installed over past year. In unit washer/dryer allowed. Pets allowed (1 dog & 1 cat with restrictions). Special assessment ($49.58/monthly) for new cooling tower until 2033, included in stated HOA. Move-in/move out charge of $300. Seize the chance to make this exceptional unit yours!  For private appointments, please reach out to Michelle Lehaney Khessibi directly.
